payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_372c7fa6286f, pid 1759) active and waiting on Lock/transactionid, blocked by session_a8961bca7237 (pid 1758), which is 'idle in transaction' after running the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and holds the row/transaction lock while waiting on ClientRead. The blocker is the root of the chain (no further blocking_session_ids). No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues: table has 2 live tuples, only the PK index, and the UPDATE is fast (mean 0.05ms). Uncertainty: none material; the fix path is rolling back the eligible idle-in-transaction blocker session per allowed operations, never touching the business request.
